additional.text: PI-01 uses released 0.6.1 and version-scoped source follow-ups. LS-01 reports synthetic, CPU and live layers; most raw live/probe receipts remain private, while maintainers replayed its offline fixture. api_use.text: If API credits are approved, we would use them for bounded OSS maintenance: reducing issue reports to minimal reproductions, proposing regression tests, reviewing compatibility changes, and keeping documentation aligned. Maintainers would approve policy changes and review patches before merge. Credits would support maintenance rather than research inference; no API integration, approved budget or automated workflow is claimed.

qualification.text: ReproLLM is an Apache-2.0, local-first CLI for auditing and recording LLM experiments. It tracks model, prompt, dependency and judge settings through manifests, locks, runtime capture and semantic diffs. Two public projects document agent-assisted use and reproducible feedback that led to documentation and .pth inventory support. Evidence and limits: https://github.com/EnumaElish123/ReproLLM/blob/main/docs/adoption/oss-evidence-2026-11.md
